result.topic_en: Hilbert proposes reducing a set of conditions by considering moduli of the form (φ, ψ, (x−a)^λ(y−b)^μ), then remarks that finding all integral rational functions invariant under a single integral linear substitution can be separated from binary invariant theory, and that invariance under infinitely many substitutions essentially yields only semi-invariants.
